⚠️ dCKB Rescuer: Deprecated ⚠️

TLDR: v1 interface retired due to Lumos deprecation and Fleek migration. Rebuild needed

Why it's deprecated

  • Framework deprecation: The UI was built on Lumos, which is deprecated, continuing to use it would be insecure and unsupported.
  • Hosting migration: Fleek migrated away from fleek.co. The previous URL (dckb-rescuer.on.fleek.co) is no longer under our control.
  • Security action: A deletion request was submitted for the old Fleek-hosted site to reduce user risk.

Immediate consequence

  • The existing v1 UI is not usable and cannot be reliably restored without a full rebuild.

Path forward

  • Full rebuild required: Replace Lumos-dependent code with CCC and rebuild the rescuer from scratch.
  • Integration plan: There's intent to fold rescuer functionality into the upcoming iCKB CCC-enabled website once ready.

More info

Tracking and discussion: https://github.com/dckb-rescuer/v1-interface/issues/2
